Hello everyone! Well, I had to finish this chapter quickly. I had to shorten it because I'll be very busy tomorrow with important family matters and won't be able to focus on continuing, so I'm taking advantage of the situation to upload it all for you today.
In this chapter, the Juggernauts Flood appear to infect the world. Meanwhile, Elisabeth prepares for the expedition with Captain Asuna.
I hope you enjoy reading the chapter. I'll keep you updated. I hope everything goes well. Thank you so much for your support!
